summary.headline: `nvs serve` is one process for requests, schedules and jobs
summary.body:
The served process runs the queue workers itself, started alongside the schedule ticker before
it begins accepting connections, so `[queue] workers` in the configuration means what it says in
production and no second process has to be deployed. Shutting down drains all three: in- flight
requests finish, the ticker stops, and a worker stops when its current job is done. The worker
count is per instance, not per core. A CLI run is unchanged.
